name: Acronym
blurb: Convert a long phrase to its acronym.
instructions:
# Instructions

Convert a phrase to its acronym.

Techies love their TLA (Three Letter Acronyms)!

Help generate some jargon by writing a program that converts a long name like Portable Network Graphics to its acronym (PNG).

Punctuation is handled as follows: hyphens are word separators (like whitespace); all other punctuation can be removed from the input.

For example:

| Input                     | Output |
| ------------------------- | ------ |
| As Soon As Possible       | ASAP   |
| Liquid-crystal display    | LCD    |
| Thank George It's Friday! | TGIF   |
example_solution:
abbreviate: function[phrase][
    replace phrase ["_" "-"] " "
    | split.words
    | map 'x -> upper  x\0
    | join
]
test_code:
import.version:3.0.0 {unitt}! 
import {src/acronym}!

describe "Acronym" [
    it "basic" [
        phrase: "Portable Network Graphics"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "PNG"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]

    it.skip "lowercase words" [
        phrase: "Ruby on Rails"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "ROR"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]

    it.skip "punctuation" [
        phrase: "First In, First Out"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "FIFO"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]

    it.skip "all uppercase word" [
        phrase: "GNU Image Manipulation Program"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "GIMP"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]

    it.skip "punctuation without whitespace" [
        phrase: "Complementary metal-oxide semiconductor"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "CMOS"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]

    it.skip "very long abbreviation" [
        phrase: "Rolling On The Floor Laughing So Hard That My Dogs Came Over And Licked Me"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "ROTFLSHTMDCOALM"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]

    it.skip "consecutive delimiters" [
        phrase: "Something - I made up from thin air"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "SIMUFTA"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]

    it.skip "apostrophes" [
        phrase: "Halley\'s Comet"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "HC"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]

    it.skip "underscore emphasis" [
        phrase: "The Road _Not_ Taken"
        expects.be: 'equal? @[
            "TRNT"
            abbreviate phrase 
        ]
    ]
]
